title: Replacement Value: When Should Royal Challengers Bengaluru Walk Away from a Bidding War?
dek: When should Royal Challengers Bengaluru walk away from a bidding war? Measuring stars against a cheap replacement shows what the premium actually buys.
excerpt: A star is only worth what he adds over the player who would replace him. For Royal Challengers Bengaluru, comparing premium signings with low-cost regulars shows how often the premium has paid.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: Value Over the Next Man In
body: A player's real value is what he adds over the player who would take his place. If a bidding war pushes the price far above that surplus, walking away is the better decision.
CricField sets Royal Challengers Bengaluru's replacement level as the median low-cost regular: {{ev:rv-repl}} tempo runs above average per hundred balls.

body: {{ev:rv-pos}} of {{ev:rv-ntop}} premium player-seasons, priced ₹8 Cr or more with a full workload, finished above replacement level.
The biggest surplus was {{ev:rv-best}}, at {{ev:rv-best-v}} runs over replacement; the chart ranks the rest.

sections.heading: The Walk-Away Price
body: A sensible walk-away price is the expected surplus over replacement, converted to money at the franchise's own cost per run. Above it, the next-best target or a cheap regular is the better buy.
For RCB, that turns a bidding-war decision into a number agreed before the auction.

sections.heading: Replacement Is Not Always Available
body: Replacement level assumes a comparable cheap player exists for every role. For scarce roles, such as an elite death bowler, the true replacement may be much worse than the median.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Set the Walk-Away Price in Advance
body: Royal Challengers Bengaluru should fix a walk-away price for each target based on surplus over replacement, adjusted upwards for scarce roles.
That discipline is how a franchise avoids paying star prices for average output.

seo.metaDescription: How much Royal Challengers Bengaluru's premium signings added over a low-cost replacement since 2018, and how to set a walk-away price.

methodology: Contribution is tempo runs above average (tRAA): batting runs above what an average batter would score from the same balls in the same season and phase, plus bowling runs saved against the average bowler in the same season and phase. Wickets and dismissals are not valued in this version. Prices come from CricField squad lists (₹ crore = 100 lakh). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Replacement level = median tRAA per hundred balls of players priced ₹1 Cr or less with at least sixty balls.
